reviews.title: If I Could Give This Scam of an App 0 Stars, I WOULD!
reviews.text: This app is extremely misleading and deceptive with its subscription practices. It advertises free access, only to begin automatically charging $5 every week. Meanwhile, the subscription information within the app advertises a monthly subscription for $5, not weekly. I never knowingly agreed to these recurring weekly charges, and I’m tired of the unauthorized billing. The app also markets itself as being affiliated with Instagram, which makes its practices even more concerning. This is unacceptable, and I strongly advise others to be cautious before subscribing or providing any payment information. I want a refund for these misleading charges and greater transparency about the actual subscription terms.

reviews.title: Good, but needs this change
reviews.text:
This app is really great but needs to stop charging for photo carousel, video editing and nearly all of their good templates. The video editor is bad. But if you decide not to pay then the interface for the things you are allowed is seamless. Photos look great and doesn't automatically stretch your photos to make them look unnatural like other apps!

reviews.title: Why?
reviews.text: Not happy! Why does the software have to be so difficult to use? Select the pictures in the right order? No! Select them in reverse order? Nope that won’t work either! Why can’t it take up the whole screen so that I can see what’s in the pictures? I don’t know maybe Layout just wants to make things more difficult on me as a user. I just don’t know. And before I post, why is it now pay to use? I’ve had this on my phone for years and used it a couple times but now I have to pay for it?

reviews.title: Another annoying bait & switch
reviews.text:
Just wanted to do a few layouts of images.  Couldn’t get past saving 2 layouts before I’m forced to sign up for a “free trial” where I’ll start getting charged  for the most basic tasks like grids/collages.  It’s just so frustrating to have to sign up for free trials just to do a few tasks that could be baked into iOS.  4.99 a week to do layouts and the same edits every other app does, it’s ridiculous.  This app and others are all the same imho.

You want reviews, this is what you’re going to get

reviews.title: trashy & hard to use
reviews.text: what happened to this app? last I had it downloaded a few years back, you could intuitively add a certain number of photos and choose templates from there. now you must pay for every little thing, but with an inflexible and counterintuitive user interface that asks for reviews and upgrades every 2 minutes. well here you are. one star. typical corporate merger quality tank. man i hate what meta has done to apps.
